sentences.en: Our dog, Rex, used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
sentences.zh: 我们的狗雷克斯过去常蹲在大门外吠叫。

sentences.en: Every time he wanted to come into the garden he would bark until someone opened the gate.
sentences.zh: 每次它想进花园时，就一直叫，直到有人把门打开。

sentences.en: As the neighbours complained of the noise, my husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.
sentences.zh: 由于邻居们抱怨狗叫，我丈夫花了好几个星期训练它用爪子按门闩好自己进来。

sentences.en: Rex soon became an expert at opening the gate.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯很快就成了开门的能手。

sentences.en: However, when I was going out shopping last week, I noticed him in the garden near the gate.
sentences.zh: 然而上星期我正要出去买东西时，看到它在大门旁的花园里。

sentences.en: This time he was barking so that someone would let him out!
sentences.zh: 这次它叫是为了让人把它放出去！

sentences.en: Since then, he has developed another bad habit.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，它又养成了一个坏习惯。

sentences.en: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside, he comes into the garden and waits until the gate shuts.
sentences.zh: 它一从外面把门打开，就走进花园，等着门关上。

sentences.en: Then he sits and barks until someone lets him out.
sentences.zh: 然后它就坐着叫，直到有人把它放出去。

sentences.en: After this he immediately lets himself in and begins barking again.
sentences.zh: 之后它立刻又让自己进来，重新开始叫。

sentences.en: Yesterday my husband removed the gate and Rex got so annoyed we have not seen him since.
sentences.zh: 昨天我丈夫把大门拆了，雷克斯气坏了，从此我们再也没见过它。
